globalNotes: Single vertically-scrolling screen titled "TODAY" with a persistent top nav bar (back chevron left, "TODAY" centered, circled "i" info icon right) that stays fixed/visible across all scroll positions. Dark theme throughout: page background is near-black (#0E1419 / #11161C) with cards on a slightly lighter dark slate (#1C232B / #20272F). A floating circular WHOOP logo button (the "/W" mark in a blue/purple gradient glowing circle) is pinned bottom-right over all content (likely the WHOOP Coach / AI assistant launcher — EXCLUDED from build). Recovery color system: green = high recovery (#16EC06 / #2CD600), yellow = medium (#F5D015 / #FFD400), red = low (#FF2D2D / #E92C2C). Chart accent line/points are light blue (#3FA9F5 / #4FB0E8). All section/metric labels are uppercase, white, bold, letter-spaced. Status bar at very top shows 09:34, silent/mute bell icon, cellular bars, wifi, battery 39%.

layout.name: Top nav bar
layout.description: Fixed header. Left: white back chevron '<'. Center: 'TODAY' in white, bold, uppercase, letter-spaced, ~15px. Right: a circled lowercase 'i' info icon (thin white ring, white serif-ish 'i'). Sits on the page background, no card. Persists across all scroll positions.
layout.interaction: Back chevron navigates to previous screen (Home/overview). Info icon opens an explainer/help sheet about Recovery.

layout.name: Recovery ring (big)
layout.description: Large centered circular progress ring (open gap at top). Track is dark grey (#3A4149); progress arc is bright green (#16EC06) filling roughly 67% of the circle clockwise from top. Inside the ring, stacked and centered: faint grey 'WHOOP' wordmark at top (#5A6470, uppercase, letter-spaced); then very large white '67' with a smaller superscript-style white '%' immediately right; below that 'RECOVERY' in white, bold, uppercase, letter-spaced, ~15px. A small downward-pointing caret/triangle sits just below the ring centered, acting as a pointer connecting the ring to the metrics card below.
layout.interaction: Static summary of today's recovery score; ring color reflects recovery zone (green = high).

layout.name: Recovery contributors metric list (card)
layout.description: Rounded dark card containing 4 metric rows separated by thin horizontal divider lines (#2C333B). Each row: left a thin-line white/grey icon, then an uppercase white bold label; right side shows a large white current value with a small grey baseline value beneath it, and a small trend triangle to the right of the big value. Rows top-to-bottom: (1) lung/lightning HR icon 'HEART RATE VARIABILITY' value '90' baseline '75' with a green up-triangle (▲). (2) heart-with-down-arrow icon 'RESTING HEART RATE' value '50' baseline '56' with a green down-triangle (▼) [green because lower RHR is good]. (3) lungs icon 'RESPIRATORY RATE' value '15.4' baseline '15.7' with a green down-triangle (▼). (4) crescent moon icon 'SLEEP PERFORMANCE' value '86%' baseline '86%' with a small grey/neutral dot marker (●, no change). Big values ~30px bold white; baseline values ~15px grey (#7A828B).
layout.interaction: Tapping a row likely opens that metric's detail/trend (mirrors the Weekly Trends charts below). Static informational rows.

layout.name: Comparison legend pill
layout.description: Full-width dark rounded pill below the metric list. Left: a small green up-triangle (▲) immediately followed by a small orange/yellow down-triangle (▼) forming a legend pair. Then white bold text 'Today' followed by grey text 'vs. last 30 days'. Explains that each row's baseline value is the 30-day average and the triangle shows today's deviation.

layout.name: HRV insight card
layout.description: Rounded card with a faint blue/purple gradient border outline. Body text in white, regular weight, ~20px: 'Your HRV is 20% higher than usual. A high HRV indicates your nervous system is ready to handle stress, your body is in balance, and you are ready to take on strain.' Below the paragraph, a tappable link row in purple/violet bold uppercase: 'EXPLORE YOUR RECOVERY INSIGHTS' followed by a purple right-arrow (→).
literals: Your HRV is 20% higher than usual. A high HRV indicates your nervous system is ready to handle stress, your body is in balance, and you are ready to take on strain.
layout.interaction: 'EXPLORE YOUR RECOVERY INSIGHTS →' navigates to a recovery insights detail page.

layout.name: Unlock behavior insights promo card
layout.description: Rounded dark card. Left column text: white bold ~22px title 'Unlock behavior insights'; grey sub-text ~17px on two lines 'Understand how your behaviors impact your recovery'; then a blue bold uppercase link 'SEE POPULAR IMPACTS' with a blue right-arrow (→). Right side: a decorative half-circle gauge/speedometer graphic (dark arc with a small magenta/purple highlight at the top of the arc and a large grey check-mark in the center).
literals: Understand how your behaviors impact your recovery
layout.interaction: 'SEE POPULAR IMPACTS →' opens behavior insights / popular impacts feature.

layout.name: Weekly Trends section header
layout.description: Large white bold mixed-case heading 'Weekly Trends', ~34px, left-aligned, sitting directly on the page background (no card).

layout.name: RECOVERY weekly bar chart (card)
layout.description: Rounded card. Header row: white bold uppercase 'RECOVERY' left, grey right-chevron '>' right. Vertical BAR chart, 7 bars (one per day). Each bar is color-coded by recovery zone with its percentage value printed above in the matching color. Three faint horizontal gridlines span the plot (roughly 33% and 66% thresholds plus a top line). X-axis labels under each bar: day abbreviation over date number. The last/rightmost column (Tue 30) is highlighted with a vertical translucent grey selection band and its date label boxed/highlighted (this is 'today'). Bars left-to-right: Wed 24 = red '25%'; Thu 25 = green '97%'; Fri 26 = green '94%'; Sat 27 = yellow '40%'; Sun 28 = red '25%'; Mon 29 = green '81%'; Tue 30 = green '67%' (selected/today).
layout.interaction: Right-chevron '>' opens the full Recovery trend detail. Bars likely selectable to inspect a day.

layout.name: HEART RATE VARIABILITY weekly line chart (card)
layout.description: Rounded card. Header: white bold uppercase 'HEART RATE VARIABILITY' left, grey right-chevron '>' right. LINE chart with light-blue (#3FA9F5) line connecting 7 open-circle markers, with a faint blue area fill beneath the line. Each point has its value labeled above in light blue. Faint horizontal gridlines. X-axis: day abbrev over date. Rightmost column (Tue 30) highlighted with translucent grey vertical band and boxed date. Points left-to-right (Wed 24 → Tue 30): 44, 107, 94, 55, 37, 93, 90. Visual shape: low start (44), spike up to 107, gradual decline to a trough at 37 (Sun), then back up to 93/90. Units are ms (implied, not printed here).

layout.description: Rounded card. Header: white bold uppercase 'RESTING HEART RATE' left, grey right-chevron '>' right. LINE chart, light-blue line + open-circle markers + faint blue area fill. Each point labeled above in light blue. X-axis: day abbrev over date. Rightmost column (Tue 30) highlighted with translucent grey band and boxed date. Points left-to-right (Wed 24 → Tue 30): 64, 51, 49, 59, 67, 52, 50. Shape: starts high (64), dips to 49 (Fri), rises to peak 67 (Sun), falls back to 52/50. Units bpm (implied).

layout.name: RESPIRATORY RATE weekly line chart (card)
layout.description: Rounded card. Header: white bold uppercase 'RESPIRATORY RATE' left, grey right-chevron '>' right. LINE chart, light-blue line + open-circle markers + faint blue area fill. Each point labeled above in light blue. Nearly flat line. X-axis: day abbrev over date. Rightmost column (Tue 30) highlighted with translucent grey band and boxed date.
